craft_evidence.owned: None (evidence): 2026 Modern Slavery Statement says "AllSaints does not own the companies or factories that produce our goods"; 175 tier-1 suppliers / 151 factories in 16 territories, sites uploaded to Open Supply Hub
craft_evidence.makers: None: no maker or factory named on any of 74 product pages read
craft_evidence.mills: None: only unnamed "Italian yarn", "Italian wool-blend", "Italian flocked denim", "British twill cloth" on product pages; licensed fibre brands LENZING ECOVERO and TENCEL named
craft_evidence.heritage: Dated and placed (claim, brand document): "Established in London in 1994" (Modern Slavery Statement 2026); about page dates the Ramskull to 1994; founders not named on brand pages
craft_evidence.process: Generic only (claim): about page says prints and graphics are designed in-house and samples are made at "our factories" (third-party); no specific making process published; certifications GOTS/OCS/RWS
craft_evidence.reasoning: AllSaints states it owns no factories and names no makers or mills on any of the 74 product pages read; the country of manufacture is stated on all but one (Turkey, Portugal, China, India, Cambodia, Vietnam, Canada). Heritage is dated and placed (London, 1994) but process is described only generically. A country and little else = 2.
